cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I sealed the first complaint in a brown envelope like yours. I'll admit it stayed in my drawer. Where's the second?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine went to the solicitor. Sealing it wasn't the same as hiding it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, confidential handling. Mine should have gone further than the drawer. Did you send yours?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The second, yes. There's a third letter on my desk that I haven't forwarded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put that beside my envelope. I've told you why mine stopped; tell me what stopped yours.

reason: Replace unsupported confidence framing with a specific copied misconception that directs the Drive, retaining seed causality only where it remains understandable in the actual dialogue.
